resources.string: A floating bubble checks fabric shown anywhere on the screen: the camera, a photo, WhatsApp or a PDF. Tap the bubble, drag the corners over the fabric and tap Analyse area.
The bubble is on. Open any app that shows fabric and tap the bubble.
Step 1 of 2: allow “Display over other apps” for Fabric Inspector, then come back and tap Start again.
Step 2 of 2: allow screen capture. Android asks this each time the bubble is started.
Screen capture was not allowed, so the bubble cannot see the fabric. Tap Start and choose Allow.
Only for flat fabric photographed straight from above in even light.
The selected area is analysed on the server and not stored.
The first start downloads the app and its AI model (about 28 MB). After that it also works without internet.
Tap the bubble for quick actions: select an area, a photo or the camera.
Drag the corners over the fabric
The screen could not be captured. Stop the bubble, start it again and allow screen capture.
No connection to the analysis server. Check the internet connection and try again.
The selected area is too small. Drag the corners to select more of the fabric.
The bubble is hidden. Tap Show bubble to bring it back.
